I did not attend Learner License test on the scheduled date of appointment?
Read more
about I did not attend Learner License test on the scheduled date of appointment?
Re-schedule the appointment, subject to availability of slots.
What happens if I am absent/ failed on the day of the Learner License Test?
Read more
about What happens if I am absent/ failed on the day of the Learner License Test?
You have to pay Retest fee and book fresh appointment.
For Retest payment visit
https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/ >> Select State >> and Click on Fee Payments >> Fee Payments.
For Re-appointment through visit
https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/ >> Select State >> Click on "Appointments" >> Slot booking Learner's License Test.
How can I take re-appointment for Learner License Test?
Read more
about How can I take re-appointment for Learner License Test?
Take re-appointment through visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/ >> Select State >> Click on "Appointments" >> Slot booking Learners' License Test.
What are the documents required to be carried to the RTO office?
Read more
about What are the documents required to be carried to the RTO office?
1. Check the application status and click on print acknowledgment which shows required documents.
2. Click on print Form 1 & can download application form & Form 1A
3. Click on Appointment letter from the same application status.
4. Fee receipt.
How to renew of Learner's License
Read more
about How to renew of Learner's License
Learners' License cannot be renewed and New Learners' License shall be issued. Applicants can visit
1. https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Click on "Expired Learner License Issue Again" from "Learner's License" menu
Learner's License print option is available but message showing this facility is not available for your state.
Read more
about Learner's License print option is available but message showing this facility is not available for your state.
This is as per the state jurisdiction; your state is not allowing printing by the applicant.
I have passed Learners License test and application has been approved, how can I download the print out?
Read more
about I have passed Learners License test and application has been approved, how can I download the print out?
Steps to Print Learner's License:-
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Click on "Learner License" menu
4. Click on print Learners License (FORM3)
5. Fill Application number & Date of Birth AND Submit.
Note: This Service is Applicable only in some states.
Is Learner's License valid throughout India?
Read more
about Is Learner's License valid throughout India?
Yes, its valid throughout India
How can I update my Learners' License mobile number?
Read more
about How can I update my Learners' License mobile number?
Steps follow for Mobile number update in License:-
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Click on "Mobile Number Update" from "Others" menu
Why should I visit RTO even after successful submission of application?
Read more
about Why should I visit RTO even after successful submission of application?
After completing online procedure for further processing of application you should visit the concerned RTO office with the required documents as shown on the acknowledgement slip. You should also carry a copy of the fee receipt

How Foreign Driver's License holder or defence personnel obtain Driver's License?
Read more
about How Foreign Driver's License holder or defence personnel obtain Driver's License?
Applicants can visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
1. Driving Licence
2. New Driving Licence. Where these options are available to apply Driver's License
I have passed in both the categories but driving license received only for single category
Read more
about I have passed in both the categories but driving license received only for single category
You need to contact your Zonal Office/Transport Department, while carrying the original document(s)
What is the validity of endorsement to drive vehicles carrying hazardous goods?
Read more
about What is the validity of endorsement to drive vehicles carrying hazardous goods?
Commercial Driving license is valid for 5 years from the date of issue. Hazardous Validities have been changed from 1 year to 3 years
What is the validity of the Driving License?
Read more
about What is the validity of the Driving License?
Private Driving license is valid for 20 years from the date of issue or till the holder attains 40 years of age, which comes earlier.
After the age of 40 the Driving licence will be issued for 10 years & then 5 years subsequently.
Validity for Non Transport Vehicles
(a) If the age of the applicant on the date of issue or renewal is less than 30 years, then the Non Transport Validity would be till the attainment of 40 years
How do I know the dispatch status of my Driving Licence to my current address
Read more
about How do I know the dispatch status of my Driving Licence to my current address

1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Select "Application Status" from menu
Status of my Application is shown as "Driver's License approved" but the licence is not yet received?
Read more
about Status of my Application is shown as "Driver's License approved" but the licence is not yet received?

Can the Driving Licence be dispatched to the applicant’s address?

about Can the Driving Licence be dispatched to the applicant’s address?

Can I go on two different dates to give driving test for different class of vehicle?
Read more
about Can I go on two different dates to give driving test for different class of vehicle?

Note: This is as per state policy.
Should I have to bring my own vehicle for driving skill test?
Read more
about Should I have to bring my own vehicle for driving skill test?
To obtaining a driving license one needs to undergo a Motor Driving test (on vehicle) but vehicle may not be required.
I have got the certificate from Driving Training School, is my Learner's License test exempted?
Read more
about I have got the certificate from Driving Training School, is my Learner's License test exempted?
Yes, it is. (This will come under the state jurisdiction)

Vahan (RC) – Vehicle Registration related questions
What is additional MV tax? Is it implied on all category of vehicles?
Read more
about What is additional MV tax? Is it implied on all category of vehicles?
Additional Motor Vehicle tax is implied on the vehicle when certain parameters exceed the prescribed limit for
the vehicle. For example – Unladen weight of vehicle exceeds 50000kg, etc.
(Applicable for Jharkhand only) I paid Motor Vehicle Tax for my vehicle; amount was debited but the receipt was not generated. Upon checking the pending transaction, I cannot locate any option for refund.
Read more
about (Applicable for Jharkhand only) I paid Motor Vehicle Tax for my vehicle; amount was debited but the receipt was not generated. Upon checking the pending transaction, I cannot locate any option for refund.
Refund option is only available for the same day of payment till 12PM. In any other case, please write to us (Link of Contact Us here)
What are the other tax components?
Read more
about What are the other tax components?
Other Tax components recovered from vehicle owner are additional MV tax, environment tax, green tax, cess, road
safety tax, Municipality Tax etc. These taxes may vary from state to state.
Do I need to pay tax when I'm is not using my commercial vehicle on road?
Read more
about Do I need to pay tax when I'm is not using my commercial vehicle on road?
If the Transport vehicle is not on Road / Not in Use, then Vehicle owner can apply for Tax Exemption of non use
period through concerned Transport department, process varies from state to state.
What is Motor Vehicle Tax and how it is decided?
Read more
about What is Motor Vehicle Tax and how it is decided?
In India, motor vehicle tax is imposed by state governments. The motor vehicle tax is calculated on the basis of
various factors including engine capacity, seating capacity, unladen weight, laden weight and cost price of
vehicle.
For how much time duration Motor Vehicle tax is paid and when?
Read more
about For how much time duration Motor Vehicle tax is paid and when?
Tax depends upon the type of vehicle For Non-Transport vehicle-Motor vehicle tax is taken at one time lifetime
(15 years). After 15 years tax can be paid during the renewal of registration for 5 years period. In most of
the state MV Tax for Non-transport
What forms are required while paying tax online?
Read more
about What forms are required while paying tax online?
There is no need of any form for paying tax online.
Why am I getting following alert message after entering vehicle registration number Alert! This service has not been activated for the concern State/RTO ?
Read more
about Why am I getting following alert message after entering vehicle registration number Alert! This service has not been activated for the concern State/RTO ?
Online tax payment facility is only available at selected State / RTO, as permitted by State Transport
Department. Only a few States and its online RTO are covered under facility.
Which mobile number do I have to use to avail online Motor vehicle tax payment option?
Read more
about Which mobile number do I have to use to avail online Motor vehicle tax payment option?
Citizen can avail this facility by entering any mobile number, he/she will get OTP for confirmation of mobile
number. After confirmation he/she can proceed further for payment process.
I am trying to pay Motor Vehicle tax but when I click on payment option nothing happens, a blank page is displayed.
Read more
about I am trying to pay Motor Vehicle tax but when I click on payment option nothing happens, a blank page is displayed.
Customer can retry for the payment after sometime and if the problem continues, he/she can contact Vahan
Helpdesk for issue reporting.

about I did not attend Learner License test on the scheduled date of appointment?

What happens if I am absent/ failed on the day of the Learner License Test?
Read more
about What happens if I am absent/ failed on the day of the Learner License Test?
You have to pay Retest fee and book fresh appointment.
For Retest payment visit
https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/ >> Select State >> and Click on Fee Payments >> Fee Payments.
For Re-appointment through visit
https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/ >> Select State >> Click on "Appointments" >> Slot booking Learner's License Test.
How can I take re-appointment for Learner License Test?
Read more
about How can I take re-appointment for Learner License Test?
Take re-appointment through visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/ >> Select State >> Click on "Appointments" >> Slot booking Learners' License Test.
What are the documents required to be carried to the RTO office?
Read more
about What are the documents required to be carried to the RTO office?
1. Check the application status and click on print acknowledgment which shows required documents.
2. Click on print Form 1 & can download application form & Form 1A
3. Click on Appointment letter from the same application status.
4. Fee receipt.
How to renew of Learner's License
Read more
about How to renew of Learner's License
Learners' License cannot be renewed and New Learners' License shall be issued. Applicants can visit
1. https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Click on "Expired Learner License Issue Again" from "Learner's License" menu

Yes, its valid throughout India

How Foreign Driver's License holder or defence personnel obtain Driver's License?
Read more
about How Foreign Driver's License holder or defence personnel obtain Driver's License?
Applicants can visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
1. Driving Licence
2. New Driving Licence. Where these options are available to apply Driver's License
I have passed in both the categories but driving license received only for single category
Read more
about I have passed in both the categories but driving license received only for single category
You need to contact your Zonal Office/Transport Department, while carrying the original document(s)
What is the validity of endorsement to drive vehicles carrying hazardous goods?
Read more
about What is the validity of endorsement to drive vehicles carrying hazardous goods?
Commercial Driving license is valid for 5 years from the date of issue. Hazardous Validities have been changed from 1 year to 3 years
What is the validity of the Driving License?
Read more
about What is the validity of the Driving License?
Private Driving license is valid for 20 years from the date of issue or till the holder attains 40 years of age, which comes earlier.
After the age of 40 the Driving licence will be issued for 10 years & then 5 years subsequently.
Validity for Non Transport Vehicles
(a) If the age of the applicant on the date of issue or renewal is less than 30 years, then the Non Transport Validity would be till the attainment of 40 years
How do I know the dispatch status of my Driving Licence to my current address
Read more
about How do I know the dispatch status of my Driving Licence to my current address
Steps to check License status:
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Select "Application Status" from menu
Status of my Application is shown as "Driver's License approved" but the licence is not yet received?
Read more
about Status of my Application is shown as "Driver's License approved" but the licence is not yet received?
You need to contact your Zonal Office/Transport Department, while carrying the original document(s)
Can the Driving Licence be dispatched to the applicant’s address?
Read more
about Can the Driving Licence be dispatched to the applicant’s address?
This is as per the state policy.
Can I go on two different dates to give driving test for different class of vehicle?
Read more
about Can I go on two different dates to give driving test for different class of vehicle?
Yes, if you have booked appointment for two different dates, you may approach for it.
Note: This is as per state policy.
Should I have to bring my own vehicle for driving skill test?
Read more
about Should I have to bring my own vehicle for driving skill test?
To obtaining a driving license one needs to undergo a Motor Driving test (on vehicle) but vehicle may not be required.
I have got the certificate from Driving Training School, is my Learner's License test exempted?
Read more
about I have got the certificate from Driving Training School, is my Learner's License test exempted?
Yes, it is. (This will come under the state jurisdiction)

Vahan (RC) – Vehicle Registration related questions
What is additional MV tax? Is it implied on all category of vehicles?
Read more
about What is additional MV tax? Is it implied on all category of vehicles?
Additional Motor Vehicle tax is implied on the vehicle when certain parameters exceed the prescribed limit for
the vehicle. For example – Unladen weight of vehicle exceeds 50000kg, etc.
(Applicable for Jharkhand only) I paid Motor Vehicle Tax for my vehicle; amount was debited but the receipt was not generated. Upon checking the pending transaction, I cannot locate any option for refund.
Read more
about (Applicable for Jharkhand only) I paid Motor Vehicle Tax for my vehicle; amount was debited but the receipt was not generated. Upon checking the pending transaction, I cannot locate any option for refund.
Refund option is only available for the same day of payment till 12PM. In any other case, please write to us (Link of Contact Us here)
What are the other tax components?
Read more
about What are the other tax components?
Other Tax components recovered from vehicle owner are additional MV tax, environment tax, green tax, cess, road
safety tax, Municipality Tax etc. These taxes may vary from state to state.
Do I need to pay tax when I'm is not using my commercial vehicle on road?
Read more
about Do I need to pay tax when I'm is not using my commercial vehicle on road?
If the Transport vehicle is not on Road / Not in Use, then Vehicle owner can apply for Tax Exemption of non use
period through concerned Transport department, process varies from state to state.
What is Motor Vehicle Tax and how it is decided?
Read more
about What is Motor Vehicle Tax and how it is decided?
In India, motor vehicle tax is imposed by state governments. The motor vehicle tax is calculated on the basis of
various factors including engine capacity, seating capacity, unladen weight, laden weight and cost price of
vehicle.
For how much time duration Motor Vehicle tax is paid and when?
Read more
about For how much time duration Motor Vehicle tax is paid and when?
Tax depends upon the type of vehicle For Non-Transport vehicle-Motor vehicle tax is taken at one time lifetime
(15 years). After 15 years tax can be paid during the renewal of registration for 5 years period. In most of
the state MV Tax for Non-transport
What forms are required while paying tax online?
Read more
about What forms are required while paying tax online?
There is no need of any form for paying tax online.
Why am I getting following alert message after entering vehicle registration number Alert! This service has not been activated for the concern State/RTO ?
Read more
about Why am I getting following alert message after entering vehicle registration number Alert! This service has not been activated for the concern State/RTO ?
Online tax payment facility is only available at selected State / RTO, as permitted by State Transport
Department. Only a few States and its online RTO are covered under facility.
Which mobile number do I have to use to avail online Motor vehicle tax payment option?
Read more
about Which mobile number do I have to use to avail online Motor vehicle tax payment option?
Citizen can avail this facility by entering any mobile number, he/she will get OTP for confirmation of mobile
number. After confirmation he/she can proceed further for payment process.
I am trying to pay Motor Vehicle tax but when I click on payment option nothing happens, a blank page is displayed.
Read more
about I am trying to pay Motor Vehicle tax but when I click on payment option nothing happens, a blank page is displayed.
Customer can retry for the payment after sometime and if the problem continues, he/she can contact Vahan
Helpdesk for issue reporting.

about How to change/update email ID after application submission?
You need to contact your Zonal Office/Transport Department, while carrying the original document(s)

Steps follow for update mobile number in License:-
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/

Can I remove any class of vehicle after submission of the application?
Read more
about Can I remove any class of vehicle after submission of the application?
Steps to follow to apply for service withdrawn:

2. Select concerned state
3. Click on "Services Withdrawn by an Applicant" License" from "Others" menu
4. Enter OTP
5. Submit your Request
Note:
This Service is available as per states customization.
How can I add another class of vehicle after submission of the application?
Read more
about How can I add another class of vehicle after submission of the application?
Steps to Modify Application:
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Select the "Add Class of vehicles" from "Others" menu
4. Enter "Application number & Date of birth" and click "Submit"
5. Fill up the Details
6. Visit RTO on scheduled date, with original documents
How to know the status of my application?
Read more
about How to know the status of my application?
Steps to check License status:
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Select "Application Status" top menu
How can I change my particulars after submission of application and completion of payment?
Read more
about How can I change my particulars after submission of application and completion of payment?
You may approach to the RTO at scrutiny counter to get them modify, but it is as per the state jurisdiction.
How can I change my particulars after submission of application and fee payment yet to be submitted?
Read more
about How can I change my particulars after submission of application and fee payment yet to be submitted?
Steps to modify Particular:

2. Select concerned state
3. Select the "Application Edit (Learners' License Only)" from "Learner's License" menu
4. Fill up Application Details
5. Visit RTO on scheduled date, with original documents
I have not received my application number on my mobile/email. Where to get application number?
Read more
about I have not received my application number on my mobile/email. Where to get application number?
Steps follow for Find Application Number:-
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Click on "Find Application Number" from "Others" menu
I am 16 Years Old, which class of vehicle I can apply.
Read more
about I am 16 Years Old, which class of vehicle I can apply.
The age criteria are as follows:
1. 16 years of age for MCWOG vehicle class (Private Vehicle)
2. 18 years of age for LMV (Light Motor Vehicle) & MCWG vehicle class (Private Vehicle)
3. 20 years of age for Transport Vehicle
4. 18 years of age for Conductor License

How to check the status of my application at any stage?
Read more
about How to check the status of my application at any stage?
Steps to check License status:
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Select "Application Status" menu
How to change/update email ID after application submission?
Read more
about How to change/update email ID after application submission?
You need to contact your Zonal Office/Transport Department, while carrying the original document(s)
How to change/update mobile number after application submission?
Read more
about How to change/update mobile number after application submission?
Steps follow for update mobile number in License:-
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Click on "Mobile Number Update" from "Others" menu
Can I remove any class of vehicle after submission of the application?
Read more
about Can I remove any class of vehicle after submission of the application?
Steps to follow to apply for service withdrawn:
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Click on "Services Withdrawn by an Applicant" License" from "Others" menu
4. Enter OTP
5. Submit your Request
Note:
This Service is available as per states customization.
How can I add another class of vehicle after submission of the application?
Read more
about How can I add another class of vehicle after submission of the application?
Steps to Modify Application:
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Select the "Add Class of vehicles" from "Others" menu
4. Enter "Application number & Date of birth" and click "Submit"
5. Fill up the Details
6. Visit RTO on scheduled date, with original documents
How to know the status of my application?
Read more
about How to know the status of my application?
Steps to check License status:
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Select "Application Status" top menu
How can I change my particulars after submission of application and completion of payment?
Read more
about How can I change my particulars after submission of application and completion of payment?
You may approach to the RTO at scrutiny counter to get them modify, but it is as per the state jurisdiction.
How can I change my particulars after submission of application and fee payment yet to be submitted?
Read more
about How can I change my particulars after submission of application and fee payment yet to be submitted?
Steps to modify Particular:
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Select the "Application Edit (Learners' License Only)" from "Learner's License" menu
4. Fill up Application Details
5. Visit RTO on scheduled date, with original documents
I have not received my application number on my mobile/email. Where to get application number?
Read more
about I have not received my application number on my mobile/email. Where to get application number?
Steps follow for Find Application Number:-
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Click on "Find Application Number" from "Others" menu
I am 16 Years Old, which class of vehicle I can apply.
Read more
about I am 16 Years Old, which class of vehicle I can apply.
The age criteria are as follows:
1. 16 years of age for MCWOG vehicle class (Private Vehicle)
2. 18 years of age for LMV (Light Motor Vehicle) & MCWG vehicle class (Private Vehicle)
3. 20 years of age for Transport Vehicle
4. 18 years of age for Conductor License

What is Drivers License backlog manual data entry, how it can be done online?
Read more
about What is Drivers License backlog manual data entry, how it can be done online?
Drivers License backlog manual data entry is meant for which Drivers Licenses data are not digitized.
Some states are allowing it at public end, otherwise you need to contact your Zonal Office/Transport Department, while carrying the original document(s)
How to apply if NT validity is expired recently but Transport validity is expired more than one year before, now I don't want to renew transport validity
Read more
about How to apply if NT validity is expired recently but Transport validity is expired more than one year before, now I don't want to renew transport validity
Steps follow to apply for RENEWAL of License :-
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Click on "Services on Drivers License (Renewal/Duplicate/AEDL/Others)" from "Driving License" menu
4. Fill up application form
5. Click on "Next Button" to proceed
6. Visit RTO on scheduled date, with original documents & Fee Slip
Note :
In case Drivers License is expired for more then 1 years, you need to undergo Driving test or may be required issuance of learning license.
How to apply for addition of class of vehicle, I have a valid learner's License
Read more
about How to apply for addition of class of vehicle, I have a valid learner's License
Steps to follow for Additional Endorsement in License :-
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Proceed for License related services
3. Select concerned state
4. Click on "Services on Drivers License( Renewal/Duplicate/Additional Endorsement of Driving Licence/Others)" from "Driving License" menu
5. Click "continue"
6. Enter "Drivers License number" and "Date of birth" click "Get Drivers License Details"
7. Fill up Application Form
8. Take appointment
I have Drivers License of state A and now I have moved to state B how can I apply for duplicate license in other state?
Read more
about I have Drivers License of state A and now I have moved to state B how can I apply for duplicate license in other state?
A permanent Drivers License is valid throughout India. However, you can visit the local RTO for more information
Is NOC required to renew my Drivers License in other state
Read more
about Is NOC required to renew my Drivers License in other state
As per rule NOC is not required for Driving License
I have two Drivers Licenses with different class of vehicle how to club/renew/duplicate it?
Read more
about I have two Drivers Licenses with different class of vehicle how to club/renew/duplicate it?
Steps follow to apply for "Drivers License CLUB" :-
1.Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/sarathiservice/stateSelection.do
2. Select concerned state
4. Click on "Drivers License CLUB" from "Apply Online" menu
5. Fill up application Form
6. Take appointment
7. Visit RTO on scheduled date original documents.
Note : This Service is Applicable only in some states.
How to surrender any specific class of vehicle category?
Read more
about How to surrender any specific class of vehicle category?
Steps to follow to apply for Surrender of COV :-
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Click on "Services on Drivers License (Renewal/Duplicate/AEDL/Others)" from "Driving License" menu
4. Fill up application form
5. Take appointment
6. Visit RTO on scheduled date with original documents.
Note : This Services is available in some states only.
For any additional service(e.g. Change of address, Duplicate etc.), you can select it from the services menu.
Any specific Drivers License related service is not showing while applying on SARATHI
Read more
about Any specific Drivers License related service is not showing while applying on SARATHI
You need to contact your Zonal Office/Transport Department, while carrying the original document(s)
I don’t know in which RTO I have to apply for Renewal of Drivers License
Read more
about I don’t know in which RTO I have to apply for Renewal of Drivers License
You need to select the RTO in which your last transaction is completed or the nearest RTO.
Latest record of Drivers License is not showing on SARATHI portal
Read more
about Latest record of Drivers License is not showing on SARATHI portal
You need to contact your Zonal Office/Transport Department, while carrying the original document(s)

Can one eyed applicant apply for the driving/learner's license
Read more
about Can one eyed applicant apply for the driving/learner's license
No
Can color blind applicant apply for the driving/learner's license?
Read more
about Can color blind applicant apply for the driving/learner's license?
Yes, you need to get the medical certificate from the hospital.
I am not able to choose COV for SCOOTY, please suggest which category should I take MCWOG/MCWG/MC50CC
Read more
about I am not able to choose COV for SCOOTY, please suggest which category should I take MCWOG/MCWG/MC50CC
Full Form for MCWOG: Motor cycle without Gear.
MCWG: Motor Cycle with Gear
MC50CC: Motor vehicle with engine capacity less than 50CC
Note: The vehicle category is as per the state jurisdiction
I am illiterate, can I apply for the driving License/Learner's License
Read more
about I am illiterate, can I apply for the driving License/Learner's License
Yes, you can apply for Driving License in India.
My name/father's middle name is more than 6 characters but system not accepting.
Read more
about My name/father's middle name is more than 6 characters but system not accepting.
You may fill it along with the first or last name.
My district/ sub district / village name is not coming in the list but it's a mandatory field. How should I proceed?
Read more
about My district/ sub district / village name is not coming in the list but it's a mandatory field. How should I proceed?
You can call us on our Helpline number: +91-120-2459169 (Timings: 06:00AM - 10:00PM)
Email: helpdesk-sarathi@gov.in(link sends e-mail)
How to apply for addition of class of vehicle in my existing Driving License
Read more
about How to apply for addition of class of vehicle in my existing Driving License
Any citizen who wants to add a category of vehicles in their license must take the following steps
Steps to follow for Additional Endorsement in License (Flow may be differ from state to state):-
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Proceed for License related services
3. Select concerned state
4. Click on "Application for New Learners License" from "Learner's License" menu
5. Select "Applicant holds Driving License, Enter DL Number"; fill your Driving License number and Date of Birth
My learner's license has expired. Could this be renewed or shall I apply for a new one?
Read more
about My learner's license has expired. Could this be renewed or shall I apply for a new one?
Learner's License validity is for 6 Months and post expiry you can only get a new Learner's License.
The expired License cannot be renewed.
My RTO name is not available/ populating on parivahan portal.
Read more
about My RTO name is not available/ populating on parivahan portal.
You need to contact your Zonal Office/Transport Department, while carrying the original document(s).
How to apply for learner's License?
Read more
about How to apply for learner's License?
Steps to for Learners' Licence for New Learner's License (Flow may be differ from state to state):-
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Click on "Application for New Learners License" from "Learner's License" menu
4. Fill up Learner's License application Form
5. Click on Next Button to proceed
6. Visit RTO on scheduled date with original documents & Fee Slip

LL – Learners License related services
I did not attend Learner License test on the scheduled date of appointment?
Read more
about I did not attend Learner License test on the scheduled date of appointment?
Re-schedule the appointment, subject to availability of slots.
What happens if I am absent/ failed on the day of the Learner License Test?
Read more
about What happens if I am absent/ failed on the day of the Learner License Test?
You have to pay Retest fee and book fresh appointment.
For Retest payment visit
https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/ >> Select State >> and Click on Fee Payments >> Fee Payments.
For Re-appointment through visit
https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/ >> Select State >> Click on "Appointments" >> Slot booking Learner's License Test.
How can I take re-appointment for Learner License Test?
Read more
about How can I take re-appointment for Learner License Test?
Take re-appointment through visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/ >> Select State >> Click on "Appointments" >> Slot booking Learners' License Test.
What are the documents required to be carried to the RTO office?
Read more
about What are the documents required to be carried to the RTO office?
1. Check the application status and click on print acknowledgment which shows required documents.
2. Click on print Form 1 & can download application form & Form 1A
3. Click on Appointment letter from the same application status.
4. Fee receipt.
How to renew of Learner's License
Read more
about How to renew of Learner's License
Learners' License cannot be renewed and New Learners' License shall be issued. Applicants can visit
1. https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Click on "Expired Learner License Issue Again" from "Learner's License" menu
Learner's License print option is available but message showing this facility is not available for your state.
Read more
about Learner's License print option is available but message showing this facility is not available for your state.
This is as per the state jurisdiction; your state is not allowing printing by the applicant.
I have passed Learners License test and application has been approved, how can I download the print out?
Read more
about I have passed Learners License test and application has been approved, how can I download the print out?
Steps to Print Learner's License:-
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Click on "Learner License" menu
4. Click on print Learners License (FORM3)
5. Fill Application number & Date of Birth AND Submit.
Note: This Service is Applicable only in some states.
Is Learner's License valid throughout India?
Read more
about Is Learner's License valid throughout India?
Yes, its valid throughout India
How can I update my Learners' License mobile number?
Read more
about How can I update my Learners' License mobile number?
Steps follow for Mobile number update in License:-
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Click on "Mobile Number Update" from "Others" menu
Why should I visit RTO even after successful submission of application?
Read more
about Why should I visit RTO even after successful submission of application?
After completing online procedure for further processing of application you should visit the concerned RTO office with the required documents as shown on the acknowledgement slip. You should also carry a copy of the fee receipt

about What is the validity of endorsement to drive vehicles carrying hazardous goods?
Commercial Driving license is valid for 5 years from the date of issue. Hazardous Validities have been changed from 1 year to 3 years
What is the validity of the Driving License?
Read more
about What is the validity of the Driving License?
Private Driving license is valid for 20 years from the date of issue or till the holder attains 40 years of age, which comes earlier.
After the age of 40 the Driving licence will be issued for 10 years & then 5 years subsequently.
Validity for Non Transport Vehicles
(a) If the age of the applicant on the date of issue or renewal is less than 30 years, then the Non Transport Validity would be till the attainment of 40 years
How do I know the dispatch status of my Driving Licence to my current address
Read more
about How do I know the dispatch status of my Driving Licence to my current address
Steps to check License status:
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Select "Application Status" from menu
Status of my Application is shown as "Driver's License approved" but the licence is not yet received?
Read more
about Status of my Application is shown as "Driver's License approved" but the licence is not yet received?
You need to contact your Zonal Office/Transport Department, while carrying the original document(s)
Can the Driving Licence be dispatched to the applicant’s address?
Read more
about Can the Driving Licence be dispatched to the applicant’s address?
This is as per the state policy.
Can I go on two different dates to give driving test for different class of vehicle?
Read more
about Can I go on two different dates to give driving test for different class of vehicle?
Yes, if you have booked appointment for two different dates, you may approach for it.
Note: This is as per state policy.
Should I have to bring my own vehicle for driving skill test?
Read more
about Should I have to bring my own vehicle for driving skill test?
To obtaining a driving license one needs to undergo a Motor Driving test (on vehicle) but vehicle may not be required.
I have got the certificate from Driving Training School, is my Learner's License test exempted?
Read more
about I have got the certificate from Driving Training School, is my Learner's License test exempted?
Yes, it is. (This will come under the state jurisdiction)

What is additional MV tax? Is it implied on all category of vehicles?
Read more
about What is additional MV tax? Is it implied on all category of vehicles?
Additional Motor Vehicle tax is implied on the vehicle when certain parameters exceed the prescribed limit for
the vehicle. For example – Unladen weight of vehicle exceeds 50000kg, etc.
(Applicable for Jharkhand only) I paid Motor Vehicle Tax for my vehicle; amount was debited but the receipt was not generated. Upon checking the pending transaction, I cannot locate any option for refund.
Read more
about (Applicable for Jharkhand only) I paid Motor Vehicle Tax for my vehicle; amount was debited but the receipt was not generated. Upon checking the pending transaction, I cannot locate any option for refund.
Refund option is only available for the same day of payment till 12PM. In any other case, please write to us (Link of Contact Us here)
What are the other tax components?
Read more
about What are the other tax components?
Other Tax components recovered from vehicle owner are additional MV tax, environment tax, green tax, cess, road
safety tax, Municipality Tax etc. These taxes may vary from state to state.
Do I need to pay tax when I'm is not using my commercial vehicle on road?
Read more
about Do I need to pay tax when I'm is not using my commercial vehicle on road?
If the Transport vehicle is not on Road / Not in Use, then Vehicle owner can apply for Tax Exemption of non use
period through concerned Transport department, process varies from state to state.
What is Motor Vehicle Tax and how it is decided?
Read more
about What is Motor Vehicle Tax and how it is decided?
In India, motor vehicle tax is imposed by state governments. The motor vehicle tax is calculated on the basis of
various factors including engine capacity, seating capacity, unladen weight, laden weight and cost price of
vehicle.
For how much time duration Motor Vehicle tax is paid and when?
Read more
about For how much time duration Motor Vehicle tax is paid and when?
Tax depends upon the type of vehicle For Non-Transport vehicle-Motor vehicle tax is taken at one time lifetime
(15 years). After 15 years tax can be paid during the renewal of registration for 5 years period. In most of
the state MV Tax for Non-transport
What forms are required while paying tax online?
Read more
about What forms are required while paying tax online?
There is no need of any form for paying tax online.
Why am I getting following alert message after entering vehicle registration number Alert! This service has not been activated for the concern State/RTO ?
Read more
about Why am I getting following alert message after entering vehicle registration number Alert! This service has not been activated for the concern State/RTO ?
Online tax payment facility is only available at selected State / RTO, as permitted by State Transport
Department. Only a few States and its online RTO are covered under facility.
Which mobile number do I have to use to avail online Motor vehicle tax payment option?
Read more
about Which mobile number do I have to use to avail online Motor vehicle tax payment option?
Citizen can avail this facility by entering any mobile number, he/she will get OTP for confirmation of mobile
number. After confirmation he/she can proceed further for payment process.
I am trying to pay Motor Vehicle tax but when I click on payment option nothing happens, a blank page is displayed.
Read more
about I am trying to pay Motor Vehicle tax but when I click on payment option nothing happens, a blank page is displayed.
Customer can retry for the payment after sometime and if the problem continues, he/she can contact Vahan
Helpdesk for issue reporting.

Steps to follow to apply for service withdrawn:

4. Enter OTP

This Service is available as per states customization.
How can I add another class of vehicle after submission of the application?
Read more
about How can I add another class of vehicle after submission of the application?
Steps to Modify Application:

2. Select concerned state
3. Select the "Add Class of vehicles" from "Others" menu
4. Enter "Application number & Date of birth" and click "Submit"

How to know the status of my application?

about How to know the status of my application?
Steps to check License status:

How can I change my particulars after submission of application and completion of payment?
Read more
about How can I change my particulars after submission of application and completion of payment?
You may approach to the RTO at scrutiny counter to get them modify, but it is as per the state jurisdiction.
How can I change my particulars after submission of application and fee payment yet to be submitted?

about How can I change my particulars after submission of application and fee payment yet to be submitted?

I have not received my application number on my mobile/email. Where to get application number?
Read more
about I have not received my application number on my mobile/email. Where to get application number?
Steps follow for Find Application Number:-
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
2. Select concerned state
3. Click on "Find Application Number" from "Others" menu
I am 16 Years Old, which class of vehicle I can apply.
Read more
about I am 16 Years Old, which class of vehicle I can apply.
The age criteria are as follows:
1. 16 years of age for MCWOG vehicle class (Private Vehicle)
2. 18 years of age for LMV (Light Motor Vehicle) & MCWG vehicle class (Private Vehicle)
3. 20 years of age for Transport Vehicle
4. 18 years of age for Conductor License

How to apply if NT validity is expired recently but Transport validity is expired more than one year before, now I don't want to renew transport validity

about How to apply if NT validity is expired recently but Transport validity is expired more than one year before, now I don't want to renew transport validity
Steps follow to apply for RENEWAL of License :-
1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/

How to apply for addition of class of vehicle, I have a valid learner's License
Read more
about How to apply for addition of class of vehicle, I have a valid learner's License

5. Fill up application Form
